I can't actually make a restaurant reservation for you, as I don't have access to booking systems or the ability to complete transactions. However, I can help you find excellent Italian restaurants in downtown Chicago where you can make a reservation for two this Friday night. Here are some top options with their reservation links:

## Recommended Italian Restaurants in Downtown Chicago

### 1. **Osteria Via Stato** (River North)
- An authentic Italian restaurant in the heart of downtown Chicago's River North neighborhood
- Features Roman-style pizzas, antipasti, pastas, and Italian specialties
- Offers a romantic candlelit dining room, casual pizzeria, or patio seating
- **Reserve at:** https://www.exploretock.com/osteriaviastato/search/ or https://www.osteriaviastato.com/

### 2. **Quartino Ristorante** (River North)
- Lively Italian restaurant and wine bar with hand-stretched pizza, pasta, and Italian small plates
- Known for warm hospitality and authentic flavors
- **Reserve at:** https://quartinoristorante.com/reservations

### 3. **Alla Vita** (Downtown)
- Accommodates parties of any size
- Reservations are recommended
- **Reserve at:** https://www.allavitachicago.com/reservations

### 4. **Labriola** (Downtown)
- Italian restaurant where "flavors come alive"
- **Reserve at:** https://www.labriolacafe.com/

### 5. **Tre Dita** (Downtown)
- Led by Chef Evan Funke, features handmade pastas, signature entrees, and steaks
- **Note:** Only accepts reservations 14 days in advance
- **Reserve at:** https://www.opentable.com/cuisine/best-italian-restaurants-downtown-chicago-il

## How to Book:
- Visit the restaurant's reservation page directly
- Use OpenTable for many downtown Chicago restaurants
- Call the restaurant directly if online booking is full

I recommend calling ahead or booking online as soon as possible, as Friday night reservations fill up quickly at popular downtown spots.
